title: For n = 0 the tangent points of a varifold are atoms of μ_V, hence countable
statement: Let N ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^N and V a 0-varifold on U (Varifold N 0 U). Then the set {x ∈ ℝ^N : HasTangentPlane V x T θ for some T ∈ G(N,0) and θ ∈ ℝ} is countable.
lean_statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclidean N)) (V : Varifold N 0 U), {x : Euclidean N | ∃ (T : Grassmannian N 0) (θ : ℝ), HasTangentPlane V x T θ}.Countable
